Post for Lab Technician
Tuesday, 17 April 2018
5307 Hits
Applications on plain paper enclosed with the certified photocopies of the educational qualification and experience are invited for the post of Laboratory Technician which must reach to the Dean, Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Medical Sciences, Po. Sevagram, Dist. Wardha 442102 latest by
30 th April 2018
. Candidates must have to submit copy of registration with Employment Exchange. Candidates belonging to Reserve Category should submit copy of Caste and Validity certificate.
Laboratory Technician – B.Sc. with DMLT from Govt. recognized Institute approved by State Technical Board / University with at least one year experience in blood bank of a teaching institute. (1 Post), which is mandatory requirement for FDA approval.
Swachhata Pakhwada April 2024
